name: tc-national-insurance
description: Turks and Caicos National Insurance Board contribution reference checked for 2026 for ordinary private-sector employment. Covers the employee and employer shares, monthly insurable earnings ceiling, payroll examples and employer registration and remittance responsibilities. Uses the Board’s current administrative rate page and distinguishes national insurance from the separate health-insurance plan. Use after the worker’s coverage and insurable earnings have been established. Public officers, self-employed workers, voluntary contributions, age transitions and detailed wage classifications require their own assessment. Conflicting self-employed figures on official pages are recorded rather than resolved by assumption. This source-cited draft awaits legislative reconciliation and independent accountant review.
